description:
Raid cost table: explosives and sulfur per building piece. The dataset behind the raid calculator. `explosives` lists every explosive the building durability data
covers: `shortname`, `name`, `icon_url`, `group` (`staples`, `other` or `siege`), `staple` (true for rockets,
C4, satchel charges, explosive 5.56 ammo and beancans - the page's default set), `sulfur_per_unit` and
`raw_cost_per_unit` (the crafting recipe resolved down to raw resources such as sulfur, charcoal, metal
fragments and low grade fuel, per single unit; both null for loot-only explosives like MLRS rockets), `batch`
(units one craft makes: explosive ammo 2, mortar shells 2) and `recipe_source` (`wiki` = the wiki's own
crafting data, `fallback` = Rust's standard recipe where that data has none yet, e.g. rockets). `targets` is
every building piece with explosive data (`slug`, `name`, `grade`, `health`), each with `costs` - for every
explosive that can damage it, `required` (how many destroy one piece), `damage_per_unit` and `sulfur` (null
for loot-only) - and `cheapest_staple`, the single staple explosive that destroys it for the least sulfur.
Damage from different explosives adds up, so a cheaper mix can be computed from `damage_per_unit`. Doors and
deployables are not covered yet. Cached for 24 hours.
name: get_raid_costs
